# descope_mailjet_connector (Resource)

Manages a Mailjet connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Send emails using Mailjet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Your Mailjet API Key, found under Account settings / API Key Management
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The Secret Key that pairs with the API Key above. Mailjet needs both to authenticate
- `sender_email` (String) A sender address verified in your Mailjet account. Defines the email sender

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.
- `sender_name` (String) The display name shown next to the sender address

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
